title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
content: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
content: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

title: Live news: Bitcoin falls back to $74,000 ahead of CPI as traders fully price in Fed rate hike
content: Fed Governor Chris Waller suggested the U.S. central bank could opt to hike 50 basis points next month if inflation didn't behave.

title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
content: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.

title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
content: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.

title: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing
content: Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate.

title: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech
content: Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting.

title: BitGo Q3 profit nearly doubles on crypto gains as revenue falls 51%
content: BitGo’s $71 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings helped nearly double its net income, but revenue and earnings came in below preliminary analyst expectations.

title: Binance Warns of Apple iOS Flaw That Could Expose iPhone Users' Private Keys
content: Apple has not publicly confirmed the "worse_query" bug, which a researcher published days before its latest iOS security update.

title: Binance Halts MEXC Transfers as FinCEN Cuts Exchange Off From US Financial System
content: The exchange will reject withdrawals to MEXC and hold deposits from it for review, after FinCEN tied it to $16 billion in suspicious flows.

title: Nvidia, Jensen Huang Sued by Shareholders Over Alleged Ties to Suspected Chinese Spy
content: A proposed class action claims the chipmaker misled investors about the CEO's alleged affair and the national security risks it posed.

title: 'Tough Questions' Ahead: Warren Targets Prediction Markets, Trump Crypto as Banking Chair
content: An aide said Trump family crypto businesses should "preserve their documents" as Warren prepares to take over the Senate Banking Committee.

title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.0 Are Impressive, But Be Prepared to Sell a Kidney to Afford Them
content: Anthropic's latest AI can build complex software and even design physical objects. Users are producing impressive results, and estimated bills large enough to make developers wince.

title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
content: Bitcoin Magazine Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares in the third quarter, a 13F shows, even as MSTR has since fallen about 18% from quarter-end. title: North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot
content: Bitcoin Magazine North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot Elliptic says North Korean launderers created six throwaway meme tokens on NEAR between Nov. 5 and 7, moving about $430,000 of stolen Binance funds through homemade liquidity pools. title: TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress
content: Bitcoin Magazine TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg puts only a 10% chance on a congressional ban on platform stablecoin yield over the next two years, even as banks renew their push after Democratic midterm wins. title: BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT
content: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT BlackRock's Robbie Mitchnick told Barron's demand to swap directly held bitcoin for IBIT shares is at its highest yet, with "security and peace of mind" the top reason as kidnappings and hacks rise.
